courses.description: By the end of Designing Indicators and Metrics That Work, you'll be able to apply indicator and metric design confidently in Monitoring and Evaluation Specialist work, with a working sense of where report writing fits alongside it. The course moves from core indicator and metric design technique through a few applied exercises, with a lighter look at report writing woven in throughout.

Practicing indicator and metric design through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to report writing
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

alternates.title: Advanced Indicator and Metric Design Techniques
alternates.description: Advanced Indicator and Metric Design Techniques goes beyond the basics of indicator and metric design, for people already working toward a Monitoring and Evaluation Specialist role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in indicator and metric design and want to go further.
